trips.title: Albanian Alps to the Riviera
trips.sub: Shkodër, Theth, Vlorë & the Albanian Riviera
trips.summary: This is the drive that shows you two Albanias in one week: the limestone Accursed Mountains where the tarmac ran out until recently, and the Ionian coast where it now runs beautifully. You begin on the flat SH1 to Shkodër, spend a day on the fjord-like Lake Koman ferry, then climb the reengineered SH21 through the Thore tunnel into Theth, a stone village under 2,500 m walls. A long transfer day drops you to the Adriatic at Vlorë, after which the Riviera unrolls, the Llogara Pass at 1,027 m, the Ottoman gunpowder bay at Porto Palermo, Butrint's Roman theatre in the marshes. It suits confident drivers who accept single-track sections, unlit tunnels and the occasional cow, and who want landscape density that Western Europe cannot match at this price.

trips.title: Grossglockner, Timmelsjoch and the Tyrolean Toll Roads
trips.sub: Hohe Tauern, Zillertal, Ötztal and the Silvretta
trips.summary: A week of Austria's paying mountain highways, Zillertal, Grossglockner, Timmelsjoch and the Silvretta, driven in the right direction at the right hour.

trips.title: Orpheus Country: A Rhodope and Rila Driving Loop from Plovdiv to Sofia
trips.sub: Western Rhodopes & the Rila Massif
trips.summary: The Rhodopes are not dramatic in the alpine sense, long, dark, spruce-covered whalebacks with villages in the folds and a road that never stops turning. Then the mountain opens a hole in itself and a river…

trips.title: Bohemia by Car, Spa Colonnades, Ore Mountains and Sandstone
trips.sub: West Bohemia, Krušné hory and the Elbe sandstone
trips.summary: A 950 km Bohemian loop from Prague through the spa triangle, along the Ore Mountains ridge and into the sandstone gorges of Bohemian Switzerland.

trips.title: Faroe Islands Subsea Loop: Eighteen Islands, Six Tunnels
trips.sub: Streymoy, Eysturoy, Norðoyar, Sandoy, Vágar
trips.summary: A seven-day road trips & scenic drive itinerary in Streymoy, Eysturoy, Norðoyar, Sandoy, Vágar, Faroe Islands.

trips.title: Route des Grandes Alpes, Lake Geneva to the Mediterranean
trips.sub: Haute-Savoie, Savoie, Hautes-Alpes, Alpes-Maritimes
trips.summary: The classic 720 km traverse from Lake Geneva to Menton across sixteen cols, driven north to south in seven stages with the light behind you.

trips.title: The B500, Schwarzwaldhochstrasse, Panoramastrasse and Baden Wine
trips.sub: Schwarzwald and the Baden wine terraces, Baden-Württemberg
trips.summary: The Schwarzwaldhochstrasse and Panoramastrasse driven end to end, with Baden vineyards, the Kandel hairpins and a Kaiserstuhl finish.

trips.title: Peloponnese Loop: Nafplio, the Mani & Olympia
trips.sub: Peloponnese, Argolid, Arcadia, Laconia, Messenia and Elis
trips.summary: The Peloponnese is the best driving peninsula in Greece precisely because it is not an island: you can build a genuine loop with no ferries, and the terrain changes every ninety minutes. This week runs Venetian Nafplio, the Argolid's Bronze Age citadels, then over the Parnon range on the Kosmas road, a genuinely great mountain drive that almost nobody does, to Monemvasia's rock. The Mani follows: tower villages, Vathia's abandoned skyline, and the road's end at Cape Tenaro where the ancients placed an entrance to the underworld. You finish through Mystras's Byzantine ruins, the Messenian coast castles and Olympia. It suits people who like ancient sites but want the driving to be the connective tissue rather than a chore.

trips.title: The Western Arc: Seven Days from the Danube Bend to the Őrség
trips.sub: Transdanubia, Danube Bend, Bakony, Balaton Uplands, Őrség, Fertő
trips.summary: A loop of roughly 870 km through the half of Hungary nobody flies in for: basalt buttes standing over Balaton like broken teeth, a stone sea in a valley of six villages, a Benedictine archabbey on a hill that has…

trips.title: Wild Atlantic Way: Dingle, Iveragh & the Burren
trips.sub: County Kerry & County Clare, Wild Atlantic Way
trips.summary: A seven-day road trips & scenic drive itinerary in County Kerry & County Clare, Wild Atlantic Way, Ireland.

trips.title: Sicily Grand Circuit: Palermo, Etna & the Val di Noto
trips.sub: Sicily, Palermo, Etna, the Ionian coast and the Val di Noto
trips.summary: Sicily is an island the size of Wales with the road inventory of a small country and the driving culture of a contact sport. This circuit runs anticlockwise from Palermo along the Tyrrhenian to Cefalù, climbs Etna's southern flank on the SP92, drops to Taormina and Siracusa, then works west through the Baroque hill towns of the Val di Noto to Agrigento's Greek temples before closing the loop at Segesta and Erice. The distances are modest, around 1,100 km, but almost none of it is fast: the autostrade are patchy and viaduct-limited, the provincial roads are beautiful and slow, and every historic centre is a Limited Traffic Zone with a camera on it. Suited to drivers who want density of sights over speed, and who will do the homework on ZTLs.

trips.title: The Rhine Alpine Triangle, Vaduz, the Silvretta and Graubünden
trips.sub: Alpine Rhine valley, Vorarlberg and Graubünden
trips.summary: One base in Vaduz, six day loops into three countries, the Silvretta, the Bregenzerwald, the Ruinaulta gorge and the Graubünden passes.

trips.title: The Grand Duchy Loop, Éislek Ridges to Moselle Terraces
trips.sub: Éislek (Oesling), Sûre Valley, Moselle & Minett
trips.summary: A 620 km loop of a country you can cross in ninety minutes, slate ridges, castle valleys, riverside vineyards and blast-furnace towns.

trips.title: The Grand Loop: Cliff Monasteries, the Prut and the Deep South by Car
trips.sub: Dniester cliffs, the northern Prut, Ștefan Vodă and Gagauzia
trips.summary: Roughly 1,050 km around a country the size of Belgium, on roads that change character every twenty minutes: fresh EU-funded asphalt, then broken Soviet concrete slab, then a clay farm track with a horse cart on it.…

trips.title: Three Corniches and the Road to Turini
trips.sub: Monaco, Alpes-Maritimes, Roya & Mercantour
trips.summary: Sea-level Riviera in the morning, 1,600 m rally hairpins by mid-afternoon, a week of driving out of a two-square-kilometre base.

trips.title: Kotor to Sarajevo via the Tara Canyon
trips.sub: Boka Kotorska, Durmitor, the Piva canyon and Sutjeska
trips.summary: This is a week of vertical geography: from a fjord that is not a fjord, over a limestone wall on a road built for a queen, across the second-deepest canyon on earth, and out through the last primeval forest in Europe into Sarajevo. The driving is the trip. The Kotor serpentine is twenty-five stacked hairpins with the Boka bay dropping away below; the Sedlo Pass at 1,907 m crosses Durmitor's stone desert; the Piva canyon road runs 56 tunnels hacked out of the gorge wall in a single 30 km stretch. It ends in a city where the road trip stops mattering, because Sarajevo is walkable and a car there is a nuisance. Suited to confident drivers comfortable with narrow, unguarded, occasionally unlit mountain roads and a border crossing in the middle.

trips.title: Driving the Defences, Delta Works to the Afsluitdijk
trips.sub: Zeeland Delta, IJsselmeer, Frisian & Groningen Wadden coast
trips.summary: 1,300 km along the works that keep a country dry, sixty-two sliding gates, a 32 km dam and the smallest tidal harbour in the Netherlands.

trips.title: Lofoten E10: Fishing Villages & Arctic Light
trips.sub: Lofoten & Vesterålen, Nordland
trips.summary: A seven-day road trips & scenic drive itinerary in Lofoten & Vesterålen, Nordland, Norway.

trips.title: The Eagles' Nests: Limestone Castles from Kraków to the Silesian Coalfield
trips.sub: Kraków-Częstochowa Upland (Jura Krakowsko-Częstochowska) and Upper Silesia
trips.summary: A short loop with an unusually high density of ruins. You drive north from Kraków along a spine of white Jurassic limestone where fourteenth-century castles were dropped onto crags like nests, some restored, most…

trips.title: The N2 Middle: Torre, Schist Villages and the Road South
trips.sub: Beira Interior, Serra da Estrela & the Alentejo Guadiana
trips.summary: The **Estrada Nacional 2** runs 738 km from Chaves on the Spanish border to Faro on the Algarve coast, crossing 35 municipalities, Portugal's Route 66, and unlike the American one, it is still the road. This week takes its central section and deliberately leaves it three times: east over the **Serra da Estrela** to Torre at 1,993 m and down the glacial Zêzere valley, east again to the granite border villages of Belmonte, Sortelha and Monsanto, and west into the schist of Piódão and the Serra da Lousã. Then it commits to the N2 proper for a long, hypnotic run south through the Alentejo to Mértola on the Guadiana. It is a driver's week: 1,100-1,200 km, a lot of second gear, and a stamp collected in every town.

trips.title: Two Roads Over the Carpathians: The Transfăgărășan and Transalpina Loop from Sibiu
trips.sub: Făgăraș & Parâng Mountains, Southern Carpathians
trips.summary: You climb out of the Făgăraș foothills in second gear, and past the eleventh hairpin the beech forest quits: nothing left but granite, snowmelt and hot brakes. A week of two mountain crossings, one famous, one…

trips.title: Nosferatu to the Silver Town: An Orava, Tatra and Spiš Castle Loop
trips.sub: Orava, the Tatras, Spiš and the Slovak Karst
trips.summary: Slovakia's castles are absurdly good and almost nobody drives between them. This loop starts under the cliff-top keep Murnau filmed as Count Orlok's lair in 1922, crosses the Orava's empty uplands, slips along the…

trips.title: Julian Alps Passes: Vršič, Predel & Mangart
trips.sub: Gorenjska & Primorska, Upper Sava, Trenta and the Soča Valley
trips.summary: Slovenia packs three genuinely serious alpine roads into an area you can cross in ninety minutes, and this week drives all of them properly rather than ticking them off. Vršič is the headline, 1,611 m, fifty numbered hairpins, several of them still surfaced in the original 1915 Russian-laid cobbles, but Mangart is the one that stays with you, a 12 km toll road drilled through five unlit tunnels to the highest asphalt in the country. Between the passes you get the Soča itself, a river the colour of glacier milk running past Trenta, Bovec and Kobarid, and a Predel crossing into Italy that takes twenty minutes and feels like a different century. It suits drivers who enjoy technical roads for their own sake, and who are content to spend an entire afternoon covering 40 km.

trips.title: Andalucía: Ronda, the Alpujarras & Cabo de Gata
trips.sub: Andalucía, Serranía de Ronda, Sierra Nevada's southern slope and Almería
trips.summary: Andalucía has more good driving roads than any other region in Spain, and this loop links three completely different ones: the cliff-edge A-397 up from the coast to Ronda, the ledge road through the Alpujarras that Gerald Brenan wrote about, and the empty desert straights of Almería. In between you climb Puerto de la Ragua at 2,000 m over the eastern shoulder of the Sierra Nevada, a crossing that goes from Moorish terraces to alpine pine to lunar badlands in ninety minutes. The week ends in the volcanic coves of Cabo de Gata, the driest place in Europe, where the roads are wide, empty and the light in October is extraordinary. It suits drivers who want variety of terrain and can navigate Spain's expanding low-emission zones without collecting fines.

trips.title: Passes and Valleys, Bernina to the Gotthard
trips.sub: Graubünden & Ticino
trips.summary: A week of high passes and warm valleys, from the Bernina and San Bernardino to the Gotthard's cobbled Tremola and the Verzasca and Maggia.

trips.title: The Pass Quadrilateral, Furka, Grimsel, Susten, Nufenen
trips.sub: Bernese Oberland, Uri and Goms (Upper Valais)
trips.summary: Four high passes inside one small triangle of Switzerland, 2,478 m at the top, granite everywhere, and a season that lasts about four months.
